query: So what do they usually do to people who play music on the street without permission?
reference_answer:
Punishment for Unauthorized Street Performances
Unauthorized street performances can result in a fine of up to ₹1,000 under the Tamil Nadu City Police Act. In some cases, performers may also be arrested for causing public nuisance.
answer: They may be asked to leave the area or face fines for playing music without a permit. [Document 1]
